info.title: State civil-rights agency complaints and charges: figures printed in state annual reports: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
State civil-rights agency complaints and charges: figures printed in state annual reports: Complaint and charge counts that state civil-rights agencies print in their own annual reports or publish as open data, one row per figure with the document's URL and a verbatim quote: California Civil Rights Department (2024 intake forms and immediate right-to-sue requests), Illinois Department of Human Rights (charges received and employment charges in fiscal year 2024, charges docketed in 2025) and the Pennsylvania Human Relations Commission (allegations in employment complaints, fiscal years 2021-22 to 2024-25 and the part of 2025-26 so far). Each quote is re-checked against the document, and each Pennsylvania figure against the portal's own aggregate. States that block the fetcher or publish no count are not included.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
